items.title: Gary Burton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I’m always next to Chick, sharing that with him. So it was fascinating to watch...not that Stefon was sort of imitating me or anything, but just to hear that song and see it being performed by the two of them... I was curious to see how he would play the tune.

ctx.x: It was fascinating. Because I’m never on the other side of the stage when that song is being played. I’m always next to Chick, sharing that with him. So it was fascinating to watch...not that Stefon was sort of imitating me or anything, but just to hear that song and see it being performed by the two of them... Every minute was interesting. And then to see how Stefon handled the part. He did things differently than I would have, and so on. So I was curious to see how he would play the tune. Mostly I was impressed…
Talk a bit about how you began your partnership with Chick Corea.
